svg.title: Downscaling climate data
svg.desc: A four by four grid of large colored cells on the left is converted by downscaling into a sixteen by sixteen grid of small cells on the right, which shows more local detail. Colors stand for a climate variable from cooler blue to warmer gold.
svg.text: Downscaling: from coarse cells to finer cells
one value for a large area
Schematic only. Colors stand for a climate variable, such as temperature, from cooler (blue) to warmer (gold). It is not California.
